description: IMPORT SETUP: select your self-hosted Windows agent pool in ALL six agent phases (queueId 0 is a placeholder); link a successful NEW CI build artifact named testpackage using alias _FF_CI; configure secret credentials. Each manual mode (Assembly, Suite, on-demand TestPlan) has a two-agent VSTest execution phase followed by ONE collector phase within the SAME deployment. Provide two available agents and parallel-job capacity. No source checkout or cross-job local-disk dependency: agents upload raw ZIPs and verified evidence attachments before job cleanup. Collector downloads current-deployment shards using OAuth and publishes RawTestResults.zip and FinalConsolidatedReport.zip as Release task log attachments, NOT Pipeline Artifacts. Extract the complete final ZIP to preserve HTML evidence links. Python 3.11 x64 must be available in each self-hosted agent tool cache. Collector identity requires View releases permission. Repository JSON changes do not update existing live definitions automatically.
